memory: I have strong evidence that τ scales with measured contact radius rather than nominal preload. At fixed 3.0 N, varying spacer radius changed Rc and τ almost linearly (R2≈0.99) up to Rc≈0.30 mm. Above that, τ overshoots the linear trend by 10–20%, implying edge or geometry effects at larger contact footprints. Single‑exponential recovery and recoverable fraction (~0.90) remain valid.
